mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its historical average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is less than 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS is below its 25th percentile is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is greater than -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as the economy slows.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% from their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) is less than -0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is greater than -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is less than 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return when INDPRO is above its 75th percentile is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1800 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors anticipate reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1800.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is greater than -0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals a deepening economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline by more than 0.5% from their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (GDPC1 * HOUST) is less than -0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 360,000 million dollars, it indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 360000.0, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC between RSAFS and 20-day returns is less than 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
